# Eduardo Visconti

> AI Engineer and full-stack developer in Tampa, FL. Builds production systems
> where an LLM agent is part of the runtime: budget ceilings, human approval
> gates, failure classification, self-healing when an upstream source changes
> shape.

## Current role

AI Engineer at United Financial Resources (Bradenton, FL) since April 2026.
Sole engineer on an automated property-deed retrieval platform with nationwide
US county coverage: 77 vendor-portal integrations behind one dispatcher, an
agent layer built on Anthropic and OpenAI tool-use, 46 architecture decision
records, and 68,672 lines of tests against 50,302 lines of source. Also builds
the client for an internal multi-agent platform, shipped through review by three
other engineers.

## Work

- Forja — his own product. Offline-first hybrid-training app: React Native,
  Next.js, PostgreSQL with row-level security. 187 pull requests, an iOS build
  on TestFlight and a written case study. https://app.forjahybrid.com
- Deed retrieval platform — private, no link. Sole engineer, 1,271 of 1,297
  commits, 77 vendor-portal integrations, nationwide US county coverage, 46
  architecture decision records.
- AI Hub — internal, no link. Multi-agent platform; he builds the Next.js and
  React 19 client with a custom NDJSON streaming protocol, against a
  Python/FastAPI/Agno backend. 32 pull requests, reviewed by three engineers.
- Sueli Repulho — client delivery, shipped. Practice site and the subscription
  product beside it, for a clinical psychologist with 42 years of practice.
  Astro, SEO-first, CI security gates. https://suelirepulho.com.br
- LeadFlow CRM — client delivery, open source.
  https://leadflow-electronics.vercel.app

## Stack

Python, FastAPI, asyncio, pytest, Playwright, PostgreSQL with row-level
security, TypeScript, React, React Native, Next.js, Docker, GitHub Actions,
Anthropic and OpenAI tool-use, MCP, RAG.
